descriptionEn: double-layer top (separate inner and outer layers) with a single wide shoulder strap and an elasticated back band, not a fitted blouse silhouette
gradeNote: approx. 1cm average variation between graded sizes; measurements correspond to the pattern's printed output

edges.position: width from fold edge to widest point

pieces.notes: Drawn as a single symmetric bowtie/hourglass outline with one straight vertical edge; interpreted as cut on fold along that straight edge given the qty of 1 and top/bottom mirror symmetry. A grading note beside this piece gives finished strap length by size: 34cm, 37cm, 40cm, 43cm (smallest to largest of four sizes) — recorded as supplementary context, not an outline edge of this piece.

A construction note beside this piece states that finished elastic length in the band varies by size, but the individual per-size cm values were too small/close together in the source to read with confidence, so they are not recorded here rather than guessed.

Small text labels along this piece (referring to a narrow-strap side vs. a wide-strap side, and a union/attachment point with the outer top layer) are construction annotations, not additional dimensions, and were not recorded as edges.
